costs: rd2/costs2.py index model: 8 bps round trip per trade (OANDA practice CFD spread model), applied adversely in price space by the harness simulator. 2x-cost sensitivity is computed for EVERY cell (not only near-bar rows) and stored on the row; sensitivity re-runs are not new trials.
counting: one (config, panel, timeframe) cell = one trial; one wf-select procedure per (family, panel, timeframe) with >= 2 variants = one trial (1d and 1h family-cells only — declared exclusion for 15m, see deviations); all RD-008 trials join the same global counter and the same Bonferroni gate as RD-001/RD-002/RD-003

data.session_structure: Yahoo cash-index bars cover the US regular session only (09:30-16:00 America/New_York). Sessions are grouped by America/New_York calendar date. Cash indices have no usable volume series (first-bar volume is 0 in the source) — every feature below is price-only; no VWAP variant is declared because its input does not exist in the data.
data.source: RD-002 Stage-A provenanced Yahoo Finance chart-API series, reused unchanged via their hash-manifested caches (SPX = ^GSPC for OANDA US500, NDX = ^NDX for OANDA NAS100): 1d 2018-01-02 -> 2026-11-13 (2,230 bars/symbol), 1h 2024-11-15 -> 2026-11-13 (3,477 bars/symbol). The runner re-verifies each CSV's SHA-256 against its sidecar manifest at load and raises on mismatch. 15m: NEW fetch by rd8/fetch_15m.py from the same Yahoo chart API (range=60d, the API's hard depth limit for 15m), cached with an RD-002-format sidecar manifest (csv_sha256 + response_sha256, null-OHLC rows dropped and counted, gap audit).
data.uncovered: Index 15m history beyond ~60 days is unobtainable from the available sources (Yahoo depth limit; OANDA API unreachable from the sandbox; Dukascopy/Stooq already shown unviable from this sandbox in RD-002). The 15m era is therefore a single ~2-month window and its cells are SCREENING ONLY (declared verdict cap below). Index overnight DRIFT (holding the closed-market window itself) remains UNCOVERED for the RD-003 reason: the window does not exist in cash-index bars. This track tests the gap AT the open and the session that follows it, which do exist in the data.
data.venue_note: The OANDA practice price API is not reachable from the research sandbox (no venue credentials in this environment; credentials live on the fleet servers and research crews do not pull them). Venue fidelity is carried by instrument choice, session structure and RD-002's OANDA-modelled index costs; TASK-STR-FWD-004's forward lane supplies live OANDA evidence for any survivor.

declaration_rule: This declaration, the family code (rd8/families_idx.py), the runner (rd8/run_idx.py) and the synthesis (rd8/synth8.py) are committed on branch claude/task-str-rd-008 BEFORE the first RD-008 cell is executed (git commit order is the evidence). No variant, threshold, cell or exit spec below may be altered after that commit; any change would be a new declaration and new trials.
deviations_declared: OPEN-AUCTION GAP FILLS: gap entries are decided at the session open from the gap itself (open[t] vs close[t-1], both known at the open) and filled at that open — implemented as signal bar = the last bar before the fill (t-1 daily; the previous session's last bar intraday). This is RD-003 Stage-2B monday_gap_fade's declared deviation, adopted verbatim: the only families in the programme using open-known information.

HOLDOUT, 2-SYMBOL ADAPTATION: rd2/stats2.holdout2 hard-requires >= 3 active symbols, so it can never pass on this mandated 2-instrument panel. Pre-declared adaptation (rd8 holdout_idx2): active-symbol gate >= 2; breadth >= 50% of active symbols positive (unchanged); concentration cap 0.8 (stats2's own small-panel rule for < 5 symbols, unchanged); untouched subset = {SPX} (the every-3rd-alphabetical rule degenerates to the empty set on 2 symbols; SPX is named here, before any run — no variant in this track is selected per-symbol, so the subset is untouched by construction), requiring pooled expectancy > 0 on >= 30 trades.

15M FOLD PROFILE 'SHORT': the harness calendar folds (W1-W5) do not exist on a 60-day sample. Pre-declared: first 10 sessions are warm-up era; the remaining sessions split into 4 consecutive blocks (S1-S4) of near-equal session counts; trades attribute to blocks by entry time; the >= 80%-positive rule applies to the 4 blocks with check_bar2's formula. 15m wf-select procedures are NOT run (wf_select_judge is bound to the W1-W5 calendar) and are not counted.

SESSION-FLAT EXIT RULE (intraday gap / zrev / rsi_rev cells only): a position still open at the end of its entry session is closed at that session's final bar close (exit_reason TIME_SESSION, costs recomputed identically). This models the day-trading mandate of the eventual OANDA CFD lane and is applied as a post-simulation exit rule using only the rule itself (no future prices). Momentum intraday cells (tsmom / donchian / ema) use plain bracket specs and may hold across sessions, exactly as RD-002's idx3 1h cells did.

families.differentiation: RD-002 batch-3's gap_daily ran on idx7 daily with different conditioning and no follow/fade mode split judged on the tradable pair; no judged cell isolates the OANDA pair (US500+NAS100) or tests the fade mode at 0.3%/0.6% thresholds with a same-day time exit. The intraday sibling (gap_intra) has no judged precedent at all: RD-003 declared index overnight mechanisms UNCOVERED because the closed window is absent — the gap at the open and the following session, tested here, are present in the data.
families.mechanism: Overnight-gap behaviour on daily bars: the cash index opens away from yesterday's close as overnight futures/news reprice. FOLLOW claim: gaps continue intraday (information diffusion is slow at the open). FADE claim: gaps over-extend and snap back within the day. Exit by the same day's close at the latest (bracket_time max_bars 1) — the claim is strictly about the gap day.
families.name: gap_daily

signal_rules.fade: SHORT if gap >= theta; LONG if gap <= -theta
signal_rules.follow: LONG if gap >= theta; SHORT if gap <= -theta
signal_rules.gap: gap_t = open_t / close_{t-1} - 1 over consecutive sessions

families.differentiation: No judged cell trades an index gap intraday; RD-002 ran no index 15m cells at all (no data was fetched) and its idx3 1h cells were trend families holding overnight. Session-bounded exits are new to the programme.
families.mechanism: The same overnight gap, traded inside the session that follows it: fill at the first bar's open, out by the session close (bracket_time max_bars = session length: 7 hourly / 26 quarter-hour bars, plus the session-flat rule). FOLLOW rides opening-drive continuation; FADE trades the well-documented opening-gap snap-back.
families.name: gap_intra

signal_rules.exit: bracket_time sl 1.5 / tp 2.5 ATR(14), max_bars 7 (1h) / 26 (15m); session-flat rule applies
signal_rules.fade: SHORT if gap >= theta; LONG if gap <= -theta
signal_rules.fill: at the session's first bar open (open-auction deviation, declared above)
signal_rules.follow: LONG if gap >= theta; SHORT if gap <= -theta
signal_rules.gap: first-bar open of session s / last-bar close of session s-1 - 1 (America/New_York dates)

families.differentiation: The harness zscore_reversion was judged on idx3 1h / idx7 1d WITHOUT session-bounded exits (positions held overnight; its time-exit variant ran 24 bars) and never on the OANDA pair or at 15m. These cells change the panel, add 15m, and bind every trade to its entry session — a different risk claim, counted as new trials.
families.mechanism: Intraday mean reversion: z-score of close vs its trailing mean; enter counter-trend on a fresh cross beyond +/-k, exit by bracket or the session close, whichever first. The index-specific claim: cash-index intraday deviations are dominated by liquidity/flow noise that mean-reverts within the session, unlike crypto's momentum-heavy intraday tape.
families.name: zrev

signal_rules.entry: LONG on fresh cross below -k; SHORT on fresh cross above +k (crossing convention identical to the harness sig_zscore)
signal_rules.exit: bracket_time sl 2.0 / tp 2.0 ATR(14), max_bars 7 (1h) / 26 (15m); session-flat rule applies
signal_rules.z: z = (close - SMA_w(close)) / SD_w(close), trailing window may span the overnight boundary (closes only)

families.differentiation: RD-002's fx_meanrev rsi2_filt was a forex cell with an EMA200 trend filter on 1h/4h/1d; no index intraday RSI-reversion cell exists in the judged set, and none with session-flat exits or at 15m.
families.mechanism: RSI-extreme reversion (Connors-style): very short RSI extremes on index intraday bars mark exhaustion, not information; fade them within the session.
families.name: rsi_rev

signal_rules.entry: LONG on fresh cross of RSI(p) below lo; SHORT on fresh cross above hi
signal_rules.exit: bracket_time sl 2.0 / tp 2.0 ATR(14), max_bars 7 (1h) / 26 (15m); session-flat rule applies

families.differentiation: Judged before on idx7 1d / idx3 1h as part of the mega-grid panels; never on the idx2 tradable pair and never at 15m on any index panel. Cells are new trials; the mechanism is deliberately the programme standard so pair-level results are comparable with RD-002's idx rows.
families.mechanism: Time-series momentum: sign of the trailing return (harness sig_ts_momentum, cross-in entries), bracket 2/4 ATR — the programme's reference trend claim, now measured on the OANDA index pair at index-appropriate lookbacks (daily: ~1/3/6 months; 1h: ~2/~8 sessions; 15m: ~0.6/~2.5 sessions).
families.name: tsmom

signal_rules.exit: bracket sl 2.0 / tp 4.0 ATR(14) (families2 BR24, the ts_momentum standard)

families.differentiation: Judged on idx7/idx3 panels in RD-002 (with three exit specs); this track fixes the programme's BR24 spec only, on the idx2 pair, and adds the never-judged index 15m cells.
families.mechanism: Donchian channel breakout (harness sig_donchian, verbatim): close beyond the trailing n-bar high/low enters with the break. Index breakouts at the open of a new range are the classic CTA claim, tested here on the pair at all three mandated timeframes.
families.name: donchian

signal_rules.entry: harness sig_donchian (close > trailing max high / < trailing min low, shifted 1), verbatim

families.differentiation: RD-002's judged EMA families were volatility-adaptive or gated (vol_adaptive_trend, voltrend2, tsmom2_dual); a plain cross was not judged on index panels. Parameter pairs are index-appropriate per timeframe and fixed here.
families.mechanism: Plain EMA fast/slow cross entries (no volatility adaptation, no gate): the simplest trend-following claim, included so the pair has a low-parameter momentum baseline distinct from breakout and roc-sign entries.
families.name: ema_cross

signal_rules.entry: LONG on EMA(fast) crossing above EMA(slow); SHORT on cross below (harness rd.common.ema)

judgement.bar: expectancy > 0 AND profit factor >= 1.2 AND >= 200 pooled OOS trades AND >= 80% of fold-profile folds positive (check_bar2 formula, incl. trades present in all but at most one fold) AND holdout pass AND Bonferroni one-sided p < 0.05 / N_running AND 2x-cost pooled expectancy > 0 with PF >= 1.2
judgement.n_running_floor: N_floor = 1,557 (global through RD-002) + RD-003 declared trials (Stage 1: 152; Stage 2: counted from results_rd3/stage2_declaration.json; Stage 2B: 21) + RD-008's 53. Concurrent Wave-4 crews (RD-004..RD-007, RD-009..RD-013) add further trials whose counts are not knowable from here, so the true final N is HIGHER than N_floor: any Bonferroni pass at N_floor is provisional, and every near-bar row reports its break-even N (the largest global N at which it would still pass).
judgement.significance_rule: Gate = Bonferroni at the running global N (RD-002 synthesis rule). Deflated Sharpe is computed and disclosed for every near-bar row but does not gate: at N ~ 1,800 with correlated heterogeneous trials its dispersion input is not identified (RD-002's stated reasoning, adopted unchanged).
judgement.verdicts: CANDIDATE = full bar + Bonferroni at N_floor + 2x-cost pass (1d/1h cells only). WATCHLIST = mechanical bar passed but significance or 2x-cost failed. SCREENING-ONLY (15m): best possible verdict is WATCHLIST-SCREEN regardless of numbers (single-era sample). FAIL = anything else, with the failed checks named per row.

panel.judgement: pooled over both symbols, per-symbol metrics reported on every row. Declared caveat: NDX constituents are a subset of the S&P 500 universe and the two series are ~0.95 correlated — pooled trade counts overstate independent evidence; same-day trade pairs are near-duplicates. The pooled bar is applied as coded (programme convention) and the caveat rides on every verdict.
panel.name: idx2

trial_accounting.note: The wf procedure count is recomputed exactly at synthesis from run output (groups with >= 2 variants among 1d/1h cells); trial_accounting in synthesis.json is authoritative.
trial_accounting.wf_select_scope: (family, idx2, tf) groups with >= 2 variants at 1d (4: gap_daily, tsmom, donchian, ema_cross) and 1h (6: gap_intra, zrev, rsi_rev, tsmom, donchian, ema_cross) = 10, plus none at 15m (declared exclusion) — recount at synthesis from the actual groups run; the runner prints the true count and synthesis uses it
